decisions.reason: As a highly visible launch on the home page and a direct extension of the firm's core cloud messaging offer in a growing market, it is a low-cost, high-fit option worth retaining while adoption uncertainty resolves.

Its dedicated page signals meaningful commitment, and document capture supports the firm's broader digital workflow direction, so the option value still appears to exceed the carrying cost after only one year.

Although only lightly featured, it fits the firm's multichannel integration logic and likely has modest incremental cost, so management would usually keep it unless customer traction quickly proves weak.

This looks like a narrow adjacent feature with less strategic prominence, but because it serves the installed fax-related business and is probably inexpensive to maintain, it is still slightly more likely to be kept than dropped.
Threat protection is strongly aligned with the firm's secure, compliant communications positioning, so despite limited website prominence it remains a valuable option to support regulated customers.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a close complement to the firm's secure email services, and with no clear failure signal yet, management would typically preserve this adjacent option for another year.
